name: effort-live-control
description: Set each Claude Code sub-agent's reasoning effort per spawn with [effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max], and let an opted-in agent's effort rise at each failing test run or red sub-task and come home once the trouble resolves.

floor.title: floor: the lowest effort a steered agent is ever sent
floor.description: The lowest reasoning effort a live-controlled agent is sent: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. A lower home level is raised to this one. An agent's effortControl.floor overrides it. Must not be above ceiling.

ceiling.title: ceiling: the highest effort a steered agent is ever sent
ceiling.description: The highest reasoning effort a live-controlled agent is sent: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. A raise stops here. An agent's effortControl.ceiling overrides it. Must not be below floor.

models.title: models: which models are steered (id prefixes)
models.description: One model id per entry, matched as a prefix of the request model, so claude-opus-5-5 also matches claude-opus-5-5[1m]. A live-controlled agent on a model not listed is sent its requests untouched.

judge.title: judge: ask the judge at a tripwire
judge.description: Off (default): every tripwire (a failing test run, a sub-task that returned red, a red result sent back) raises the effort one step. On: a tripwire makes one cheap model call that estimates the probability that the trouble continues; the effort rises one step only when it is at least judgeRaiseAt. An agent's effortControl.judge overrides it.

judgeRaiseAt.title: judgeRaiseAt: the probability that raises the effort
judgeRaiseAt.description: With the judge on: a probability (0 to 100) at or above this raises the effort one step; below it the effort holds. The judge never lowers it.

tripwires.title: tripwires: which events raise the effort
tripwires.description: The armed tripwires, comma-separated: fail1 (the first failing test run), fail2 (the 2nd failing run in a row, then every even count), red (a sub-task returned red), redispatch (a red result sent back). A disarmed tripwire is counted but raises nothing; empty arms none. An agent's effortControl.tripwires overrides it.

judgeModel.title: judgeModel: the model that judges
judgeModel.description: The model alias or id of the judge call (it costs one call per tripwire).

judgeEffort.title: judgeEffort: the judge call's own effort
judgeEffort.description: The reasoning effort of the judge call: low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

judgeTimeoutMs.title: judgeTimeoutMs: milliseconds the judge call may take
judgeTimeoutMs.description: A judge call that has not answered after this many milliseconds is dropped and the effort rises one step instead.

buttons.title: buttons: give agents effort_up and effort_down tools
buttons.description: On: every agent can call effort_up and effort_down; a live-controlled agent moves its own effort one step, any other is refused. Off: the tools are not registered.

announce.title: announce: tell the agent when its effort changes
announce.description: On: the agent's next tool result carries one line naming its new effort and why. Off: it is not told.

testCommandPatterns.title: testCommandPatterns: which commands are test runs (regular expressions)
testCommandPatterns.description: One regular expression per entry, matched case-sensitively against a foreground Bash command. A match makes the call a test run, counted as failing or passing; a background run counts neither way.

failurePatterns.title: failurePatterns: what counts as a failing test run (regular expressions)
failurePatterns.description: One regular expression per entry, matched case-sensitively against a test run's result. A run whose result is an error or matches any entry fails; any other passes.

redWords.title: redWords: words that open a red return line
redWords.description: A sub-agent answer or a read result whose line is WORD, WORD name or WORD name: detail with one of these words is a failed return. Case-sensitive.

greenWords.title: greenWords: words that open a green return line
greenWords.description: Like redWords, for a return that clears an earlier red one from the same unit.

agentDirs.title: agentDirs: extra directories of agent definitions
agentDirs.description: One directory per entry, searched after .claude/agents of the project, of CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and of the home directory, for the definition of an agent type (its effort and effortControl).

logFile.title: logFile: the decision log (JSONL)
logFile.description: Where decisions are appended, one JSON row per decision, request and event, never prompt or tool-result text. The session id is inserted before the extension, one file per session; the newest 5000 rows are kept. A leading ~ is your home directory. Empty: no log.

logPackets.title: logPackets: put the judge's snapshot and answer in the log
logPackets.description: On: judge rows carry the snapshot sent to the judge and its answer, which holds the agent's opening brief and last words. Off: they do not.
